name: 12 Labors
source: You are Heracles of Argolis  and after living in your family’s castle, you decided to leave it and live in the city to enjoy your life to the fullest. Until one fateful night, Zeus and Hera, god and goddess of the Greek pantheon, decided to take you to Mount Olympus to challenge you. Accomplish their labors and you’ll become a god or fail… and you’ll die.
